title: Valence Band EELS Tomography of Poly-Si Semiconductor Nanostructure
content:
Abstract
Valence band electron energy loss spectroscopy (VEELS) technique has several advantages in imaging and shows promise for visualizing 3D volumes of complex Si nanostructures. To evaluate this technique, a polycrystalline Si electric contact was analyzed using VEELS tomography, and the data were compared to those obtained by energy-filtered transmission electron microscopy (EFTEM) tomography on both a slab-like sample with ±60° partial tilt and a needle-like sample with ±90° full tilt. VEELS tomography using the multiple linear least squares (MLLS) method for fitting provided a higher signal-to-noise ratio, less imaging artifact, and a better spatial resolution 3D structure with tomography reconstruction compared to the EFTEM imaging method based on a Si 16eV plasmon peak.
